summary.intent: Act on a peer Claude session's request to finish the onboarding-friction worktree: keep the 'could not check for pending version work' note stderr-only (not in init's JSON report), reorder init's queued notes before 'Next steps' per CLI-WF-01, then merge origin/main and run the full gate.
summary.outcome: Edits were made to release.rs, init.rs, init/tests.rs and the changeset, init tests were run twice, and a signed commit was attempted (retried via rtk after the first form). The merge of origin/main, the full gate, and the convergence record were not reached in this transcript.

repo: DiagnosticCode::PendingVersionWork means pending work was FOUND; a failed check must not be reported under it, so it stays a stderr-only note (as release --dry-run does).
CLI-WF-01 in docs/specs/*.json defines the init output order: merge note, advice ('Merging to <branch> publishes: require pull requests...'), then next steps.
Commits in this repo are GPG/SSH signed (git commit -S, verified via git log --format='%h %G?').
Shell commands are wrapped with the rtk prefix (rtk cargo, rtk grep, rtk just); the first non-rtk 'just fmt' commit attempt was re-issued with rtk.
Builds are run with CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 to limit resource use.
The full gate is: just pre-push && just lint && just doc-check && just test, checked by exit code with network unsandboxed.
